name: hook_inline_ac_ti_only
description: Cross-process inline hook of an ac_client.exe function via 5-byte JMP + trampoline. RQ3 evasion: only ETW-TI subscribed.

extra.target_selection_notes: Fill in --rva with the RVA of an ac_client.exe function you want to hook. To find a hookable candidate: (1) dumpbin /DISASM path\to\ac_client.exe > ac_disasm.txt; (2) search for a per-frame handler (clientevents, updateweapons, execute); (3) subtract the image base (typically 0x00400000 for a 32-bit MSVC/MinGW build) from the function VA to get its RVA. The disassembler auto-picks preserve_bytes so any function with a normal prologue works. --verify-hits 0 accepts install-only capture (some AC functions are only called on specific events).
extra.expected_fingerprint: 1x ALLOCVM_REMOTE (RWX trampoline, ~4KB, allocated within ±2GB of target for x64 or anywhere for x86), 1x READVM_REMOTE (prologue probe read, 32 bytes), 1x WRITEVM_REMOTE (trampoline write, ~4KB), 1x PROTECTVM_REMOTE (.text → RWX for preserve_bytes bytes), 1x WRITEVM_REMOTE (detour write into .text, 5 bytes + NOP padding), 1x PROTECTVM_REMOTE (.text restore). No THREAD_CREATE_REMOTE.
